headline: Australia house prices plunge at fastest pace in 40 years
summary: Australian house prices fell for a seventh consecutive month. Property research indicates the decline speed is tracking at its fastest pace in four decades.
why: Housing market downturns affect household wealth, domestic consumer confidence, and bank mortgage portfolios, serving as a primary indicator for Australian economic health.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Rapidly falling property prices compress domestic wealth and weigh on banking sector residential lending books.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Seven consecutive months of accelerating price declines signal severe contraction in the Australian real estate sector.
